terminal_bonus: 3 once when the assigned success criterion is reached
selection: final epoch only, from scratch, original archived PPO config
evaluation: CPU PhysX, deterministic policy means, independent of training, common 600-frame first episodes, no success reset, drops absorbing
holdout: X tilt stratified uniformly over [-5,+5] degrees per bank; fixed identity reference additionally scored separately
primary_outcomes: 16 consecutive valid samples starting at first entry, conditional on any entry
secondary_outcomes: 16 samples from first entry, all starts
censoring: first entry after step 585 counts as an observed entry but cannot demonstrate the first hold by horizon; report number of such entries
effects: equal training-seed weights; marginal differences average the two levels of the other factor; interaction is difference of termination effects (improvement minus proximity); undefined conditional rates reported separately
secondary_backend: Repeat the identical four held-out/reference banks using GPU PhysX as in training. Compare algorithms within each backend; never pool CPU/GPU outcomes.
